children.description: See information about database connections, including authentication failure counts and trends; session statistics and details; and top remote hosts, users, databases, and applications.

panels.name: Authentication Status
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Redshift/Audit* ("authenticated" or "authentication failure")
| parse regex "^(?<event>[\w]+[\w\s\']*)\|(?<eventDetails>.*)"
| parse "*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as event, recordtime, remotehost, remoteport, pid, dbname, username, authmethod, duration, sslversion, sslcipher, mtu, sslcompression, sslexpansion, something1, application_name
| if (event matches "authenticated*", "authenticated", if (event matches "authentication failure*", "authentication failure", event)) as event
| count as %"Requests" by event
| where event in ("authenticated", "authentication failure")

panels.name: Connection Session Stats
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Redshift/Audit*  ("initiating session" or "disconnecting session")
| parse regex "^(?<event>[\w]+[\w\s]*)\|(?<eventDetails>.*)"
| parse "*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*|*" as event, recordtime, remotehost, remoteport, pid, dbname, username, authmethod, duration, sslversion, sslcipher, mtu, sslcompression, sslexpansion, something1, application_name
| join
(where event matches "initiating session*") as t1,
(where event matches "disconnecting session*" ) as t2
on t1.pid = t2.pid and t1.remotehost = t2.remotehost and t1.remoteport = t2.remoteport
| fields t1_pid, t1_remotehost, t1_remoteport, t1_username, t2_duration, t1_recordtime , t2_recordtime, t1_application_name,  t1_dbname, t1_authmethod, t1_sslversion, t1_sslcipher
| t1_pid as pid | t1_remotehost as remotehost | t1_remoteport as remoteport | t1_username as username | t2_duration as duration | t1_recordtime as connection_recordtime | t2_recordtime as disconnection_recordtime | t1_application_name as application_name | t1_dbname as dbname | t1_authmethod as authmethod | t1_sslversion as sslversion | t1_sslcipher as sslcipher
| count as eventCount by pid, remotehost, remoteport, username, duration, connection_recordtime, disconnection_recordtime

panels.name: Session Duration Stats
panels.queryString:

| where event matches "disconnecting session*" 
| count as sessionCount, sum(duration) as totalSessionTime, avg(duration) as avgSessionTime, min(duration) as minSessionTime, max(duration) as maxSessionTime, pct(duration, 90) as %"90%ile", pct(duration, 95) as %"95%ile"by username
